kind.description: `node`: a component maps it; `type`: its architecture type alone covers it; `unmapped`: it exists and nothing covers it; `missing`: no such file; `excluded`: coverage never looks at it, by design.

direct.description: For a node owner: whether a mapping names the file itself (false: an ancestor directory does).

enforced.description: For a type owner: whether any of the type's rules apply to the file.

candidates.description: For an unmapped file: the components that map other files in its directory, most first — the likely owners to add it to (empty when none does, and for every other kind). Added in 6.1.0.

next.description: The command that shows the file's rules, when there is one.
